claims.paraphrase: Page title.
A custom screen's motion follows the shipped admin's vocabulary and is audited like the engine's own screens.
Precondition pointer to the custom admin screen page.
The design system Motion section is canonical; the page points to the audit reference and the design system.
Section heading.
Eight motion custom properties are declared on both admin theme roots.
The five duration values and the three easing token names.
An unmarked transition utility resolves to the base duration and standard curve through the root defaults.
Section heading.
Four motion rules run over admin screens, three error tier and one advisory.
motion-property fails names outside the allowlist or in the layout list; the fix message tells you what to do.
The motion-property fix message says to drop the property or use the frame-offset allowance.
motion-vocabulary fails literal durations and curves; the message names the nearest token.
motion-hover-gate fails an unguarded hand-authored hover rule with motion; the message asks for the guard.
motion-reduced-delay is advisory and rendered, flagging computed nonzero delays under reduced motion.
The three static rules are admin-only and resolve over the admin scope, so public pages never trip them.
Section heading.
A second audit surface resolves markup class tokens through the compiled sheet, unlike the authored-CSS surface.
Vendor DaisyUI classes and six Tailwind transition utilities are exempt; an arbitrary transition form is checked.
Only a literal static attribute value earns the frame-offset allowance; a computed value does not.
The allowance is one element per screen, a screen being one component file, counted in document order.
A frame offset is a persistent-frame mode change like zen; claim the allowance instead of suppressing.
The carrying element may transition margin-left and nothing else.
Snippet putting the attribute and a Tailwind arbitrary transition class on one div.
The exception is keyed on attribute plus property; a second property or second carrier is a finding.
Section heading.
A hover and focus pair in one selector list needs splitting for the hover gate.
Snippet of a combined hover and focus selector list with an invented accent token and no transition.
Wrapping the whole list carries focus-visible into the guard and removes focus motion on touch.
Snippet of the split form with an invented class and accent token.
A test fixture catches a focus-visible alternative mistakenly kept within the hover guard.
Section heading and the note that neither configuration is required by default.
static.cssFiles already reaches token-colors; naming a theme file feeds the CSS-family motion rules.
static.adminScope defaults to three roots; name the roots if admin screens live elsewhere.
Section heading.
Paint transitions may re-enable motion under reduced-motion via an important restatement; the shipped admin does not use this.
Each restatement costs one allowlist entry in the site's own custom-surface budget file.
Layout and transform motion cannot opt back in; the floor applies.
Section heading.
A clean audit run has no findings from the three named motion rules.
The rendered delay rule shows no new findings when reduced motion is emulated.
